scope: Four completed thirty-second isolated headless browser phases, release engine; no profiler.
decision: Sustained dense-map performance gate remains open. Profile later simulation states before further optimizations.
limitations: The same maximum mixed opening resets before each phase.
Clock droppedSeconds is cumulative across phase resets; do not interpret it as per-phase.
No total app/GPU memory or storage measurement.
Headless browser timing does not establish physical-display smoothness.
